scope: Owner-approved isolated numerical-seed stability and paired saved-outcome checks. No new outcomes, production integration, paper promotion, or independent confirmation.
candidate: Same direct residual-probe sample covariance tested in VENETO_RESIDUAL_PROBE_CANDIDATE_2026-09-08.md; all existing model, positivity, rank, solver and interval gates unchanged.

veneto.interpretation: Numerical stability screen, not statistical coverage; inference seed changes Gram, covariance, spectrum and critical probes together. No best-seed selection.

saved_outcomes.range_convention: start inclusive, end exclusive; historical outcome master seeds and generators unchanged
saved_outcomes.preflight: One paired saved draw per selected cell, validated schema, seed/point identity, status accounting, and deliberate malformed CLI exit before the main manifest. No new draws.
saved_outcomes.hard_checks: Complete inventory and every attempted replication; original saved outcome/point identities; current model, Counter, solver and moment certificates; no hidden failures or conditional-only coverage reporting.

primary_screens.availability: Original family-specific correct_success_rate on originally eligible targets
primary_screens.coverage_floor: 0.95 - max(original family coverage_absolute_tolerance, original family coverage_mcse_multiplier * sqrt(0.95*0.05 / attempted replications))
primary_screens.other_original_gates: Also report original two-sided calibration flags without relabeling failures. Keep original target eligibility, including nonprimary match-q1 covariance.

saved_outcomes.diagnostic_screens: Report all outcomes, failures, floor shares and calibration; known null, multi-mode, estimated-control and severe-misspecification cases do not become coverage claims.
saved_outcomes.decision: Any screen failure requires diagnosis and owner discussion before integration; do not retune thresholds, exclude targets or choose successful seeds after observing results. Passing is bounded development only.
